g.text: Graph-assisted recovery retains the four-data local Gauss measurement
Two consecutive equal records; at most four
Joint affine decoder: one class -> Pauli repair
Ambiguous/absent -> reject; discard flagged root vote
After repair, remain in V coordinates for the next code record. No global twenty-data CZ measurement is introduced.

One faulty CX(s,A0) applies X_s X_A0. Reported root flags: f4 = f5 = 1 (word 48).
Certified data syndrome = 0; cycle syndrome = 0. Graph-blind decoder: ambiguous. Joint decoder: unique class I.
